hook: Your walk outside Longyearbyen comes with a rifle.
title: The Town Where You Carry a Rifle for Bears
description:
In Longyearbyen, in Norway's Svalbard, polar bears live beyond the edge of town. Leave the settlement and you're expected to carry protection, usually a rifle. Part of the series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Svalbard #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you go outside? Yes or no
